# Real Property Planning

Real Property Planning provides specialized real estate guidance for probate and estate property sales, senior transitions, and trust-owned real estate throughout Washington State, with deep experience across Western Washington and the Puget Sound region.

## Who we serve
Attorneys, executors, trustees, fiduciaries, and families navigating the sale of inherited or estate-owned property. Also serves seniors and families transitioning from longtime homes to assisted living or smaller housing. Clients throughout Washington State and, through eXp Realty's referral network, connections to trusted brokers across the U.S. and internationally.

## What makes us different
Real Property Planning brings together licensed Washington State real estate brokerage and Washington State certified residential appraisal expertise — over 20 years of combined experience. This dual capability means clients receive both professional valuation insight and skilled brokerage representation in one relationship.

## Services
- Probate and estate property sales
- Trust-owned real estate sales
- Senior transitions and downsizing support
- Condition-based pricing and preparation strategy

## Areas served
Washington State, with a strong focus in King County, Snohomish County, Pierce County, Skagit County, and Kitsap County across Western Washington and the Puget Sound region. Cities include Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Mercer Island, Issaquah, Everett, Edmonds, Tacoma, Gig Harbor, Bainbridge Island, and more. Through eXp Realty's referral network, clients can also be connected with trusted brokers across the United States and internationally.

## Adult Family Homes (AFH Club)
"Adult family home" is Washington State's licensing term for a residential home licensed by DSHS to care for up to six (occasionally eight) adults. Other states use different terms for the same model — adult foster home (Oregon, Michigan), residential care facility for the elderly (California), assisted living home (Arizona), personal care home (Georgia, Pennsylvania), family care home (North Carolina).

AFH Club is Real Property Planning's section for families choosing a home and for operators buying, selling, licensing, or running one. It includes a directory of every licensed adult family home in King, Pierce, and Snohomish counties (4,046 homes, 23,580 licensed beds, from DSHS licensing records), with capacity, specialty designations (dementia, mental health, developmental disabilities), DSHS contracts, and Medicaid status for each home. Every city, filter, and facility page is a real URL with structured data.

- [AFH Club hub](/afh-club): Start here for adult family homes in Washington.
- [What is an adult family home — and what is it called in your state?](/afh-club/what-is-an-adult-family-home): Definition plus a state-by-state table of licensing terms, agencies, and capacities.
- [Directory of licensed homes by city](/afh-club/homes): 4046 homes across 67 cities.
- [Tacoma](/afh-club/homes/tacoma): 375 licensed homes
- [Lynnwood](/afh-club/homes/lynnwood): 311 licensed homes
- [Everett](/afh-club/homes/everett): 306 licensed homes
- [Kent](/afh-club/homes/kent): 285 licensed homes
- [Federal Way](/afh-club/homes/federal-way): 275 licensed homes
- [Lakewood](/afh-club/homes/lakewood): 270 licensed homes
- [Renton](/afh-club/homes/renton): 200 licensed homes
- [Auburn](/afh-club/homes/auburn): 190 licensed homes
- [Marysville](/afh-club/homes/marysville): 188 licensed homes
- [Puyallup](/afh-club/homes/puyallup): 181 licensed homes
- [Seattle](/afh-club/homes/seattle): 153 licensed homes
- [Bellevue](/afh-club/homes/bellevue): 135 licensed homes
- [Adult family home listings](/afh-club/listings): Every current AFH opportunity in Washington, in three groups.
- [Properties for sale](/afh-club/listings/properties): Houses that are licensed, formerly licensed, WABO-ready, or marketed for AFH use.
- [Businesses for sale](/afh-club/listings/businesses): Operating AFH businesses sold with or without the real estate.
- [For lease](/afh-club/listings/for-lease): Licensed and AFH-ready houses available to rent to an operator.
- [Buying & selling an AFH](/afh-club/buying-selling): How AFH real estate and business transfers (CHOW) work.
- [Licensing & certification](/afh-club/licensing-certification): DSHS licensing requirements.
